facts.text: The Bellevue Palace is the official guesthouse of the Swiss government.
facts.excerpt: As the official guesthouse of the Swiss government, the Bellevue Palace has been a place of living history for over 150 years.

facts.text: The Bellevue Palace has been a place of living history for over 150 years.
facts.excerpt: the Bellevue Palace has been a place of living history for over 150 years

facts.text: The Bellevue Palace stands right next door to the Bundeshaus, the Federal Palace, in Bern.
facts.excerpt: Bern is the Capital of Switzerland and the Bellevue Palace stands right next door to the Bundeshaus, or Federal Palace.

facts.text: The hotel offers views of the Bernese Alps.
facts.excerpt: offers magnificent lounges, superb views of the Bernese Alps and heartfelt hospitality

facts.text: The hotel is a venue for diplomats and politicians and a common meeting hub for Bern.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is an iconic venue for diplomats and politicians and a common meeting hub for the whole of Bern.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the only Grand Hotel in the heart of the Swiss capital.
facts.excerpt: It is the only Grand Hotel in the heart of the Swiss Capital

facts.text: Brasserie VUE serves a contemporary take on traditional brasserie dishes in a lounge-style atmosphere.
facts.excerpt: French. Urban. Chic. VUE has it all: a relaxed environment, a lounge-style atmosphere and a contemporary take on traditional brasserie dishes.

facts.text: Le Lobby is a meeting place for informal snacks and drinks.
facts.excerpt: A true classic reborn, a convivial meeting place to exchange views and discuss weighty matters over informal snacks and drinks.

facts.text: Noumi Bar & Grill offers signature drinks from the mixologist and lounge music, for lunch, after-work and casual dinners.
facts.excerpt: Signature drinks from the mixologist and lounge music make Noumi a hotspot for lunch, after-work and casual dinners.

facts.text: The Bellevue Bar has a Fumoir, Le Fumoir, devoted to aficionados of fine tobacco.
facts.excerpt: «Le Fumoir» is devoted to aficionados of fine tobacco.

facts.text: The Bellevue Bar is an established meeting place connecting business people, politicians, couples and bon viveurs.
facts.excerpt: A legendary bar with a proud tradition connecting business people, politicians, courting couples and quiet bon viveurs in the heart of Bern.

facts.text: The hotel serves an afternoon tea with mini sandwiches, scones and petits fours presented on an etagere.
facts.excerpt: enjoy mini sandwiches, scones and exquisite petits fours presented on a étagère in homage to Versaille

facts.text: The hotel has a Finnish sauna with separate areas for men and women.
facts.excerpt: The sauna has separate areas for men and women.

facts.text: The Bellevie Gym has Excite+ cardio machines, Element+ weight training machines and a lounge with a self-service gym bar.
facts.excerpt: modern Excite+ cardio machines with TV and connectors for Smartphones, Element+ weight training machines and a lounge with self-service gym bar

facts.text: Suites include a Deluxe Suite, a Tower Suite and a Presidential Suite.
facts.excerpt: Deluxe Suite Tower Suite Presidential Suite

facts.text: The old town of Bern, with its arcades and historic fountains, is a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site.
facts.excerpt: With its miles of arcades and historic fountains, the old town of Bern is a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site

facts.text: In summer the banks of the River Aare are a recreation area for strolling, jogging and swimming.
facts.excerpt: In the summer, the recreation area along the banks of the River Aare is ideal for strolling, jogging and swimming.

facts.text: Bern is a starting point for excursions such as the Jungfraujoch, a boat trip on Lake Thun or Gruyere Castle.
facts.excerpt: Whether a visit to the world-famous Jungfraujoch, a boat trip across the turquoise-green Lake Thun or the discovery of Gruyère Castle, there is something for everyone.

facts.text: The hotel is at Kochergasse 3-5, Bern.
facts.excerpt: Kochergasse 3-5, Bern

facts.text: The hotel was a Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2017 honoree.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2017
